commands.sentence: Keep private advisories off the public ledger, naming those ready to publish: Writes nothing bare, only the embargo store; refuses an unknown sub-verb.

next.when: to take new private advisories into the embargo store
to see the publication plan for those ready

commands.sentence: Check a commit range or texts for what would disclose an advisory under embargo: Writes nothing; refuses on each id, reserved CVE id, title or store path found.

next.when: when nothing in the range discloses an advisory under embargo

commands.sentence: Show an advisory's closing text and digest, or close it on GitHub with it: Writes GitHub and the store only with --approve; refuses a digest for other text.

next.when: to see the advisories still under embargo

commands.sentence: Record the commits that fix an advisory under embargo: Writes only the embargo store; refuses a commit id that is not a commit of this repository.

next.when: to see the publication plan the fix makes ready

commands.sentence: Take this repository's private advisories into private records in the embargo store: Writes only the embargo store; refuses a remote that is not on GitHub.

next.when: to record a verdict on an advisory taken in

commands.sentence: Show the publication plan with computed patched versions, or publish it: Writes GitHub and the store only with --approve; refuses a digest for another plan.

next.when: to close an advisory once it is published

commands.sentence: Queue each ready advisory's publish step for the person's return: Writes only the away queue, each step once; refuses while the person is not away.

next.when: only when the person says yes, once they are back, to print what was queued

commands.sentence: Record a verdict on a private advisory, drafting a closing verdict's text: Writes the embargo store; refuses an unknown verdict or one missing its reason.
commands.example: abcd embargo triage GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx not-a-vulnerability --by "<who decided>" --reason "the behaviour is the documented one"

next.when: once the commits that fix the advisory exist
